Container.Name: tv-mt5-signal-bridge
Container.Overview: Receives TradingView webhook alerts and pushes them over ZeroMQ to the mt5-windows container's Expert Advisor. Part of tv-mt5-bridge -- a self-hosted TradingView-to-MT5 bridge. Requires a shared webhook secret and the mt5-windows container running alongside it.
Container.Requires: Install mt5-windows too. The defaults work as-is on Unraid's default bridge network. Leave WEBHOOK_SECRET blank to have one generated; your TradingView webhook URL is printed in this container's log on first start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the webhook. Point your Cloudflare tunnel at http://[your Unraid IP]:[this port].

Config.Name: ZMQ_HOST
Config.Description: Where the EA's ZeroMQ port is reachable. 172.17.0.1 (the Docker host on the default bridge network) works when mt5-windows runs on this server; otherwise use that server's LAN IP.

Config.Name: ZMQ_PORT
Config.Description: ZeroMQ PULL port the EA listens on

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave blank to generate one on first start (saved in the Config path as webhook_secret, and the full webhook URL is printed in the log). Or set your own long random string.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional: your tunnel's https address (e.g. https://tv-webhook.example.com), so the log prints the exact TradingView webhook URL.

Config.Name: REQUIRE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave true for anything reachable from the internet. Only set false for local-only testing.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Keeps the generated webhook secret across restarts and updates
